title: KENWORTH T904-T908 FUPS Compliant Road Train Bullbar #64
description: Kenworth T904-908 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar 550mm style channel. Standard 88mm diameter pipe but optional 100mm pipe can be ordered. 100mm box additional height uprights. Special LED mount bar fitted to centre of the bar. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Optional Dangerous Goods sign. Provision for front mudflaps. Spring tilt assist. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
